name: ConcertinaFAQ
job: A question list built as concertina-folded paper where opening an answer unfolds its pleats in 3D and closes the others
visitor_action: click/tap or Enter on a question; arrows move between questions
mobile: fewer pleats, answer fades in after the fold
motion: pleats rotate open with spring and shadow shift, neighbours fold shut (reduced-motion: plain height change)
art_direction: Quiet stationery: warm off-white card stock, single ink-indigo accent, subtle light/shade pleat facets, no frame gradient
